newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON FANS VOTE TO LEAVE GOODISON PARK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON FANS VOTE TO LEAVE GOODISON PARK.

text.p: Everton fans have voted overwhelmingly in favour of moving to a new 60,000 capacity all-seater stadium.
More than 80 percent of the 21,974 fans who replied to a poll said they were in favour of chairman Peter Johnson's plans for a new stadium.
The premier league club have been playing at Goodison Park, which has a capacity of 40,000, since 1892.
